title: Pool-X upgraded to KuCoin Earn
description: KuCoin upgraded the Pool-X product identity to KuCoin Earn on 22 December 2021, including the Pool-X Earn, Staking, Pool-X Account and Flexible Terms naming and account changes described in its first-party announcement.
notes: This records the verified KuCoin Earn brand transition, not the initial launch of all predecessor Pool-X yield services.

title: Flexible earning products consolidated
description: KuCoin announced the integration of Simple Earn Savings, Simple Earn Flexible and Crypto Lending Pro into Simple Earn Flexible while the KuCoin Earn platform remained active.
notes: Product consolidation is recorded separately from the overall platform status and does not imply closure of KuCoin Earn.

title: Simple Earn documented in OKX Earn guide
description: An OKX first-party Earn guide published on 14 November 2022 described Simple Earn as part of the exchange's Earn product suite, establishing a verified existence date for the service without asserting that date as the exact launch date.
notes: This is a first-verified-existence milestone. CYA does not infer an exact umbrella-service launch date from the publication date.

title: Simple Earn Fixed made broadly available
description: OKX stated that Simple Earn Fixed became available to all eligible users from 30 May 2024, with supported fixed-term lending products whose returns begin after matching with borrowing demand.
notes: This is a product-expansion milestone and is not treated as the launch date of the broader Simple Earn service.
